arena: [생존기] Cloak of Shadows instantly removes all harmful spell effects and resists harmful spells for 5 sec. Use it when enemy casters send CC spells or magic burst.
[생존기] With Preemptive Maneuver, Feint grants an extra 25% damage reduction while you're stunned and costs 30% less Energy. Pop Feint right before you get stunned.
[생존기] Evasion increases your dodge chance by 100% for 10 sec. Use it when melee DPS pop burst cooldowns and get on you.
[제어] Kidney Shot lasts longer with more combo points, up to an 8 sec stun. Lock down the enemy healer and pop Adrenaline Rush to burst meanwhile.
[제어] Gouge incapacitates for 4 sec from the target's front and Blind disorients for 1 min, but damage can break both. Put them on the enemy healer and have your team attack another target.
[분담] Smoke Bomb creates an 8 yd smoke cloud around you for 5 sec, and enemies can't target into or out of it. Drop it next to your kill target so the enemy healer outside can't heal them.
[차단] Kick interrupts a cast and locks that school for 6 sec. Save it for the enemy healer's heals.
[제어] Dismantle disarms an enemy's weapon and shield for 5 sec. Use it when weapon-wielding melee DPS pop their burst cooldowns.
bg: [참고] Stealth classes are good at base defense. Hide in Stealth next to the base flag you're guarding, then Cheap Shot enemies that come to capture for a 6 sec stun.
[참고] Per map rules, a flag carrier that stealths drops the flag. Don't use Vanish or Stealth while holding the flag.
[위치] Grappling Hook pulls you to a spot up to 40 yds away. Use it to chase an enemy flag carrier who escaped onto a roof or upper floor, or to quickly support a base under attack.
[분담] Shroud of Concealment stealths allies within 30 yds for 15 sec. Use it to lead a small group into an enemy base or cart unseen, and Sap an out-of-combat defender for 1 min.
[생존기] Healing taken is reduced by 20% in battlegrounds. Rather than waiting on heals, use Feint, Evasion and Cloak of Shadows right before the burst.
[제어] Enemies disoriented by Blind can't be knocked back. Use it on enemies trying to capture a base, but don't overlap it with your team's knockbacks.
pvpTalents: Smoke Bomb, picked by 39 of the top 41 Solo Shuffle players and all 33 Battleground Blitz players, creates an 8 yd smoke cloud enemies can't target into or out of. Dismantle, picked by 33 of 41 Solo Shuffle and 27 of 33 Battleground Blitz players, disarms an enemy's weapon and shield for 5 sec. Preemptive Maneuver, picked by 25 of 33 Battleground Blitz players, adds 25% damage reduction to Feint while stunned.
